details.command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$files = rg -l -S 'live-supervisor-e2e' '.coding-tools\orchestration\reports' --glob 'wave-*.md'; foreach($f in $files){ $m = Select-String -LiteralPath $f -Pattern 'EPERM|EBUSY|ENOTEMPTY|EACCES'; if($m){ Write-Output ('FILE|'+$f); $m | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (($_.LineNumber).ToString()+'|'+$_.Line.Trim()) } } }"
